inputs.text: A T-shirt design featuring a stunning ocean wave scene, evoking the spirit of surf culture and beach lifestyle. The image showcases a serene beachscape with crystal clear water, perfect waves for surfing, and a vibrant sun setting behind it all. The composition is simple yet striking, focusing on the beautiful natural elements while maintaining a clean and modern aesthetic. A bold font displays the phrase 'Ride the Waves' in a stylish yet readable way. The color palette consists of ocean blues, sandy beiges, and sunset oranges, creating an inviting atmosphere. This T-shirt design is perfect for print-on-demand production, appealing to those who love the beach, surfing, and the great outdoors.

Avoid overly complicated designs or elements that don't work well on a T-shirt such as small text or detailed illustrations. Poor quality indicators include pixelated images or low-resolution visuals.
